_comment: All pricing math lives in this file. Engineers own the SpEL runtime + sandbox + BigDecimal precision (ExpressionStrategy); the policy team owns every formula and note here. To change how flights are priced, edit this file and restart — no rebuild, no code review of Java. Notes are SpEL too, so string literals need single quotes.

strategies.name: demand-based
strategies.note: bookedRatio >= 0.90 ? '2.0x very high demand (>= 90% booked)' : bookedRatio >= 0.75 ? '1.5x high demand (>= 75% booked)' : bookedRatio >= 0.50 ? '1.2x moderate demand (>= 50% booked)' : '1.0x low demand'

strategies.name: time-to-departure
strategies.note: hoursToDeparture < 3 ? '2.0x last-minute (< 3h to departure)' : hoursToDeparture < 24 ? '1.5x same-day (< 24h to departure)' : hoursToDeparture < 168 ? '1.1x within a week' : '1.0x plenty of runway'
